title: 第1章 少年秦易第2章
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 罗云帝国，青云城。
时值冬天，大雪弥漫，寒风瑟瑟。
漆黑的夜晚，阴森恐怖的墓地上空，飘过阵阵寒风。
一个瘦弱的身影，身上穿着单薄的衣衫，似乎寒冷对他而言，并没有那么可怕。
尽管他面红耳赤，小手都在发抖，但却满脑子都在想着自己的妹妹。
秦易抑制住自己内心的恐惧，在一具具的尸体面前寻找。
突然，他听到了微弱的声音。
猛地转头走向后方，赫然发现，妹妹浑身沾满鲜血，倒在尸群中，奄奄一息。
秦易蹲下身来，紧紧的握住妹妹的小手，但是却发现，妹妹的手掌已经僵硬。
意识快要迷离的秦欣儿，看到哥哥后，嘴角挤出一丝笑意，艰难的松开手掌。
“哥哥……这是……”
秦欣儿断断续续的说着，掌心中赫然是一颗黝黑的丹药。
秦易不断摇头，痛苦的看着妹妹，将其拥入怀中。
“丹药我们不要了，哥哥带你回家。”
秦易用尽全力，想要将妹妹抱起来，但是刺骨的寒冷，让他无法站立，一个跄跄，眼前一黑，直接摔倒在大雪中。
“哥哥……我不后悔！”
临死之前，还能见哥哥一面，秦欣儿不后悔为哥哥做的事情。
说完之后，眼一闭直接失去了生机。
略显悲伤的声音，自秦易口中传出。
他蹲坐在妹妹身旁，伸出那冻得通红的小手，轻轻的抚摸着妹妹的秀发。
“为什么，为什么要这样？”
秦易内心充满悲伤。
这一刻，寒冷的冰雪，落在他身上，都没有了知觉。
他恨这苍天，对妹妹的不公。
天寒地冻，让他全身冰冷，而妹妹的死，则彻底打破了秦易心底最后的坚强。
他强忍着心中的悲痛，送妹妹最后一程。
黑夜如墨，厚重的乌云藏起了圆月，阴风在乱葬岗上吹过，吹起了满地的纸钱草灰。
一座新立的墓碑前，两根蜡烛摇摇晃晃，火光好似随时会被熄灭一般。
十三岁的秦易孤身一人，在这漆黑的夜空下守墓。
content_en:
Luo Yun Empire, Qingyun City.
It's winter, with heavy snow and cold wind.
In the dark night, gusts of cold wind drifted over the eerie cemetery.
A thin figure, wearing thin clothes, it seems that the cold is not that terrible to him.
Although his face was red and his little hands were shaking, he was thinking about his sister.
Qin Yi suppressed the fear in his heart and searched in front of the corpses one after another.
"Gulu..."
Suddenly, he heard a faint sound.
He suddenly turned his head and walked towards the back, and was shocked to find that his sister was covered in blood, lying among the corpses, dying.
"Sister..."
Qin Yi knelt down and held his sister's little hand tightly, but found that her sister's palm was stiff.
Qin Xin'er, who was about to lose consciousness, squeezed out a smile from the corner of her mouth when she saw her brother, and loosened her palm with difficulty.
"Brother...this is..."
Qin Xin'er said intermittently, and there was a dark pill in her palm.
Qin Yi kept shaking his head, looking at his sister in pain, and hugged her into his arms.
"We don't want the elixir anymore. Brother, I'll take you home."
Qin Yi tried his best to pick up his sister, but the biting cold made him unable to stand. He staggered, his vision went dark, and he fell directly into the heavy snow.
"Brother...I don't regret it!"
Before she died, she could still see her brother. Qin Xin'er did not regret what she had done for her brother.
After saying that, he closed his eyes and immediately lost his life.
"Sister..."
A slightly sad voice came from Qin Yi's mouth.
He squatted next to his sister, stretched out his little hands that were red from the cold, and gently stroked her hair.
"Why, why is this happening?"
Qin Yi's heart was filled with sadness.
At this moment, the cold ice and snow fell on him, making him unconscious.
He hated the sky for being unfair to his sister.
The freezing cold weather made his whole body freezing, and the death of his sister completely broke the last strength in Qin Yi's heart.
He suppressed the grief in his heart and sent his sister on her last journey.
"Woo——"
The night was as dark as ink, and the thick dark clouds hid the full moon. The dark wind blew over the mass graves, blowing up the ashes of paper money and grass all over the ground.
In front of a newly erected tombstone, two candles flickered, and the fire seemed to be extinguished at any time.
Thirteen-year-old Qin Yi was alone, guarding the tomb under the dark night sky.
